Package io.telekom.orchest.scheduling.api

Interface TaskScheduler

All Known Implementing Classes:
DefaultTaskScheduler
public interface TaskScheduler
Producer-facing API for scheduling deferred work.

Implementations are required to be thread-safe and idempotent on (type, businessKey) — repeated schedule(TaskScheduleRequest) calls with the same pair update the existing row instead of creating a duplicate.

    • schedule

      ScheduledTask schedule(TaskScheduleRequest request)
      Schedule a task. If a task with the same (type, businessKey) already exists, its trigger time, payload and attempt counter are reset.
      Returns:
      the persisted task (with store-generated id populated).

    • schedule

      default ScheduledTask schedule(String type, String payload, Instant triggerAt)
      Convenience overload — schedules a task to fire at triggerAt with no business key (i.e. always creates a new row).
